messages:
Nikita: Quick heads-up — hitting a conversion bug when moving an HF jinja-style chat_template to Redwood prompt. Multiline quoted block gets collapsed/merged into the next role. Repro below.

Nikita: ```jinja
{% set chat_template = [
  {"role":"system","content":"You are concise."},
  {"role":"user","content":"Summarize:
"""
Line one

Line two with "quotes" and - bullets
"""
"}
] %}
```

Matt: Huh. That triple-quote block looks like a Jinja raw/quoted region — maybe the renderer is trimming newlines. Do you see role markers like `<|user|>` being stripped during conversion? :thinking_face:

Nikita: Yes — after conversion we end up with a single-line result: `System: You are concise. User: Summarize: Line one Line two with "quotes" and - bullets` (newlines gone, and user content fused into assistant start).

Sam: Can you paste the tokenizer tokenization for the original content? maybe whitespace/newline tokens are being lost when we inject sentinels.

Nikita: Token preview (byte-level): `["Summarize", ":", "Line", "one", "\n", "\n", "Line", "two", "with", '"', "quotes", '"', "and", "-", "bullets"]` — the `\n\n` exists pre-render but ends up as spaces after conversion.

eval-bot: quick-eval: ran the prompt set on the quantized 4-bit build + conversion. Result: ROUGE-L -8 points vs baseline, perplexity +12% on prompts with multiline quoted blocks. Marked as quality regression.

Matt: Possible root causes: (1) Jinja's strip_blocks / lstrip_blocks config is enabled by default in our env, (2) chat_converter does a `.join(messages, ' ')` somewhere, or (3) tokenizer special token mapping for triple quotes isn't preserved -> they're removed.

Nikita: Minimal workaround that helped me: wrap the quoted block in a sentinel placeholder before template render, then replace sentinel with original text post-conversion. Ugly but preserves newlines. Example: `{{ '<<QUOTE_1>>' }}` pre-render and swap back.

Sam: Long term fix: configure the Jinja env to preserve raw blocks or use `{% raw %}...{% endraw %}` for ambiguous sections. Also add `keep_trailing_newline=True`/`autoescape=False` where appropriate. We should add a unit test for chat_template roundtrip with multiline code/quote.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary build `chat-conv-fix-2098` created and deployed to eng-ml alpha at 2098765800.

Nikita: Picking up the canary now and running the eval harness against the same prompt set (multiline-quote suite). Will post numbers.

eval-bot: canary-eval: ROUGE-L delta now within 0.5 vs baseline, perplexity delta -0.8%. Regression resolved on this suite.

Matt: Great. Please open a PR with the config change + unit tests + the eval artifact link and tag me for review. :+1:

Nikita: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-internal/pull/4923 — adds `jinja: keep_raw_blocks=true` and `chat_converter: preserve_newlines=true`, includes `tests/test_chat_template_multiline.py`. cc @Matt @Sam

Sam: I'll review the PR and the tests. If green, let's merge and schedule an eng-runtime canary rollout to dedicated infra later today.

Nikita: Sounds good — thanks everyone.
